title: The Counterexample Game: Iterated Conceptual Analysis and Repair in Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates the performance of LLMs in conceptual analysis, specifically using a set of 20 concepts that include several moral and ethical terms such as 'to lie', 'to cheat', 'to forgive', 'to steal', 'to promise', and 'to consent'. It also references existing literature on machine moral judgment and model alignment.
